Skills

• Strong experience in UX Research and UI Design.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent communication skills to present ideas and collaborate with different stakeholders.

• Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Maze, and others.

• Strategic thinking, context awareness, and ability to adapt solutions to project needs.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Colaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Payroll Project Manager
description:
Location : Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Duration : 9 Months (Fixed-Term Contract), Starting Feb 2026

Reporting to: Director


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced Payroll Project Manager to lead the end-to-end implementation of Client’s new payroll system and service model. You will serve as the primary bridge between Client’s internal stakeholders (HR, Finance, IT), local partner and Neeyamo implementation teams. Your mission is to ensure that the implementation is seamless, compliant with Brazilian labor laws (CLT), and delivered on time and within budget.


Key Responsibilities

 Project Leadership: Act as the single point of contact for the external payroll provider,

ensuring their delivery matches our business requirements and local statutory needs.

 Implementation Oversight: Manage the full implementation lifecycle: discovery, data

migration, parallel runs, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and \"Go-Live.\"

 Stakeholder Management: Facilitate weekly status meetings with internal leadership and the

provider’s project team to track progress and unblock issues.

 Data Migration & Quality: Lead the cleansing and mapping of legacy data into the new

provider’s platform, ensuring 100% accuracy in employee records and year-to-date balances.

 Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to automate workflows between HRIS and the

new payroll platform to reduce manual intervention.

 Risk Mitigation: Maintain a Risk & Issue Log, proactively identifying bottlenecks that could

delay the 10-month timeline.

 Planning : Compliance: Support future implementation planning, prepare Wave Plans, and

ensure adherence to project management frameworks


Qualifications & Skills

 Experience: 7+ years in Payroll implementations &; project management or HR Project

Management, with at least 2 successful large-scale payroll implementations.

 Local Expertise: Knowledge of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and the eSocial framework is

beneficial.

 Language : Fluency in Portuguese and English (required for global reporting).

 Technical Savvy : Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana) and

advanced Excel. Experience/ knowledge on any Ewaider& ;Co suite of products will be an

additional advantage.

 Communication: Strong negotiation skills to manage vendor performance and expectations.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL com Informatica.
  • Realizar análise de dados para apoiar modelagem e integrações.
  • Criar e otimizar consultas Oracle SQL para performance.
  • Documentar processos e repassar conhecimento para o time.



O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Conhecimento em Informatica e SQL
  • Experiência com SQL em Oracle
  • Experiência em iImplementar workflows ETL no Informatica



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI & Orchestration)
description:
Company Description


A Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.


Mais informações: Coru Website


Job Description


Como Senior Software Engenieer, você irá liderar a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento da nossa plataforma de orquestração de agentes de IA. A sua missão não é \"reinventar a roda\" no que diz respeito aos LLMs, mas sim construir uma infraestrutura robusta, escalável e flexível que integre as melhores soluções do mercado numa experiência de utilizador perfeita. Será uma peça fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma para um orquestrador de IA de classe mundial.


Responsabilidades:


1. Arquitetura e Orquestração

  • Design do sistema: arquitetar micros serviços escaláveis e camadas de orquestração que possam lidar com vários fornecedores de IA e fluxos de trabalho complexos de agentes;
  • Estratégia de integração: avaliar e integrar serviços de IA de terceiros (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, etc.), garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos;
  • Desenvolvimento de API: projetar e manter APIs de alto desempenho e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para dar suporte a interações em tempo real com agentes.


2. Full-Stack Development (Node.js/React)

  • Excelência em backend: criar serviços seguros, testáveis e sustentáveis usando NestJS e TypeScript;
  • Integração de frontend: colaborar no frontend Next.js/React para garantir que resultados complexos de IA sejam apresentados de forma intuitiva para os utilizadores;
  • Gestão de bases de dados: projetar e otimizar esquemas de bases de dados relacionais (SQL) para dar suporte à gestão complexa de estados para agentes de IA.


3. Produtividade aumentada por IA

  • Fluxo de trabalho moderno: usar e defender ativamente ferramentas de desenvolvimento baseadas em IA (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) para acelerar a entrega e manter a qualidade do código.
  • Evolução contínua: manter-se atualizado sobre as ferramentas e estruturas de IA mais recentes para garantir que a nossa camada de orquestração permaneça na vanguarda.


4. Liderança e Mentoria

  • Visão técnica: fornecer orientação técnica sobre decisões de \"Build vs buy\" relacionadas com componentes de IA;
  • Melhores práticas: defender código limpo, CI/CD e padrões rigorosos de documentação dentro da equipa de engenharia.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência: Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Backend: Forte proficiência em Node.js e TypeScript (experiência com NestJS é uma vantagem significativa);
  • Frontend: Sólida experiência com React e Next.js;
  • Bases de dados: Conhecimento especializado em SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou similar);
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experiência com AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker e pipelines CI/CD modernos;
  • Ferramentas de IA: Conforto e alta proficiência na utilização de assistentes de codificação de IA (Cursor, Copilot) para aumentar a produtividade pessoal e da equipa.


Competências Essenciais

  • Mentalidade generalista: capacidade de resolver problemas em toda a pilha sem estar vinculado a um nicho específico \"apenas de IA\";
  • Pensamento arquitetônico: capacidade de projetar sistemas modulares e fáceis de adaptar à medida que o panorama da IA muda;
  • Orientado para resultados: focado em entregar valor ao utilizador, em vez de projetar ferramentas internas de forma excessiva.


Desejável/ Plus

  • Experiência na criação ou manutenção de fluxos de trabalho ou orquestradores Agentic;
  • Familiaridade com bases de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate) ou arquiteturas RAG;
  • Experiência com Python (para pontes de serviço de IA específicas);
  • Compreensão da observabilidade e gestão de custos de LLM.



Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:

-Somos Todos Líderes.

-Rendirse jamás!

-El único problema que no podemos resolver es aquel del que no podemos hablar.

-All together: Diversidad de historias y vivencias. Diferentes visiones traen mayores horizontes.


Você está #TheOne?

-Cartão de benefícios flexível Caju

-Salário competitivo

-Convênio médico Alice e odontológico Amil sem coparticipação

-Somos uma empresa \"Remote First\"

-Plano de carreira em uma empresa em rápido crescimento

-Fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está revolucionando o mercado e melhorando a vida das pessoas em cada interação.

  • Consulting & mentorship ($10,000–$40,000)
  • Franchise packages ($20,000–$100,000+)
  • Online academies & virtual education
  • SaaS subscriptions
  • AI products (AllianceVoice.ai, etc.)


Each product vertical will have 3–5 dedicated closers , and we are scaling aggressively.


About the role:


As a Remote Closer, you will handle qualified inbound leads generated through our marketing funnels. Your job is to consult prospects, understand their goals, and enroll them into the program or product that best fits their needs. This is NOT cold calling.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a performance-driven environment, communicates with clarity and empathy, and excels at closing digital product sales via Zoom or phone.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct scheduled sales calls (Zoom or phone) with warm, pre-qualified leads.
  • Follow a proven sales framework while incorporating your own style.
  • Ask powerful questions to understand client goals, challenges, and fit.
  • Present the offer clearly and handle objections professionally.
  • Maintain accurate call notes and pipeline updates in the CRM.
  • Collaborate with the sales team for continuous improvement.
  • Meet or exceed weekly and monthly closing targets.
  • Uphold brand values and represent our company with integrity.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 1–2 years of closing experience, preferably in digital products (courses, coaching, SaaS, education, consulting).
  • ​Strong communication and emotional intelligence.
  • Confidence in leading consultative sales conversations.
  • Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace.
  • High ownership mindset and ability to work independently.
  • Coachable, growth-oriented, and comfortable receiving feedback.
  • Familiarity with CRMs (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Close, or similar).


Preferred (Bonus)

  • Experience in high-ticket closing ($1k–$15k offers).
  • Understanding of online marketing funnels.
  • Background in personal development, business coaching, or tech.


Compensation

  • Commission-based  (industry-leading payouts)
  • OTE:

* $8,000–$20,000/month

* Top performers: $30,000–$50,000+/month

  • Upside based on productivity — no ceiling
  • Quick promotion for consistent closers
  • Opportunity for promotion to Senior Closer or Sales Lead.


What We Offer

  • Inbound, qualified leads (no cold calling).
  • A proven, in-demand digital product suite.
  • Weekly training, call reviews, and performance coaching.
  • Supportive, high-performance remote sales culture.
  • Flexible hours (within US time zones).​

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting‑edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.

We are looking for a talented and motivated UX/UI Designer to join our UX team. If you are proactive, organized, and passionate about creating exceptional user experiences, we want to meet you!


Responsibilities

• UX Research: Conduct research using techniques such as desk research, user and stakeholder interviews, benchmarking, surveys, persona creation, user journeys, empathy maps, user flows, sitemaps, and more.

• Perform tests such as user testing, shadowing, field research, tree testing, and A/B testing to generate valuable insights during project discovery.

• UI Design: Develop low-, medium-, and high-fidelity prototypes, creating visually appealing and functional interfaces aligned with user and project needs.


Requirements

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in UX and UI projects.

• Intermediate English for conversation is required.

• Spanish is considered a plus.


Skills

• Strong experience in UX Research and UI Design.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent communication skills to present ideas and collaborate with different stakeholders.

• Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Maze, and others.

• Strategic thinking, context awareness, and ability to adapt solutions to project needs.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. title: Tech Lead (.NET)
description:
Se você gosta de liderar times, orientar tecnicamente, tomar decisões que movem o projeto e ainda colocar a mão no código quando necessário, essa oportunidade de Tech Lead .NET é a sua chance de criar impacto real e escalar produtos de verdade!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa.

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server, incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD, testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento.

- Boa comunicação, com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (JavaScript/Vue.js/Node.js)
description:
Localização: Remoto Brasil

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Início: Imediato

Duração: Contrato de longo prazo

Horário: Horário flexível com overlap para colaboração com o time

Skills: JavaScript - Vue.js - Node.js - MySQL - Capacitor - Firebase - Capgo

Integrações: MapBox - HubSpot - Zapsign - Jobber - Discord - Amplitude - Intercom

Inglês para leitura e escrita


Sobre a Vaga

Estamos procurando um Senior Full-Stack Developer para assumir a liderança técnica de uma aplicação web e mobile . Esse é um papel hands-on em que você vai tomar decisões de arquitetura e escrever código. Você vai trabalhar com uma stack JavaScript moderna (Vue.js, Node.js, MySQL ) e gerenciar o ciclo completo das aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até o deploy . Precisamos de alguém que pense na escalabilidade enquanto coloca a mão na massa para construir funcionalidades e resolver problemas.


Se você se sente à vontade em ambientes colaborativos, adora resolver desafios complexos e quer gerar impacto real em um produto em crescimento, essa vaga é para você.


Responsabilidades
  • Liderar a direção técnica das aplicações web e mobile, tomando decisões arquiteturais importantes
  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades usando Vue.js (frontend) e Node.js (backend)
  • Projetar e otimizar bancos de dados MySQL para performance e escalabilidade
  • Gerenciar integrações com serviços terceiros como MapBox, HubSpot, Aurora, Zapsign, Jobber, Discord, Amplitude, Intercom
  • Supervisionar processos de deploy para web (Firebase Hosting) e mobile (iOS/Android via Capacitor)
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código
  • Melhorar workflows de desenvolvimento, incluindo pipelines de CI/CD, estratégias de testes e documentação
  • Mentorar e guiar outros desenvolvedores, promovendo qualidade de código e boas práticas
  • Colaborar de perto com o time de produto para transformar requisitos em soluções técnicas sólidas
Requisitos
  • Expertise sólida em JavaScript, Vue.js e Node.js
  • Boa comunicação em inglês (leitura e escrita)
  • Domínio de MySQL (versão 8.0+)
  • Experiência fazendo deploy de aplicações web no Google Cloud (Firebase Hosting preferencial)
  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de apps mobile usando Capacitor
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e/ou e2e)
  • Histórico comprovado integrando APIs de terceiros e gerenciando integrações complexas
  • Confortável com processos manuais de deploy e capacidade de melhorar automação ao longo do tempo
  • Excelente capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade de trabalhar de forma independente


Diferenciais
  • Experiência com Capgo para distribuição de updates mobile
  • Experiência configurando pipelines de CI/CD e melhorando workflows de DevOps
  • Familiaridade com publicação de apps mobile na App Store e Google Play
  • Conhecimento de plataformas de analytics como Amplitude ou similares
  • Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou contribuidor sênior em times pequenos e ágeis
Por que se juntar a nós
  • Lidere desde o primeiro dia: Molde a visão técnica de um produto em crescimento
  • Trabalhe remotamente: Flexibilidade total com uma cultura focada em resultados
  • Impacto real: Suas decisões vão influenciar diretamente o sucesso do produto
  • Oportunidades de crescimento: Conforme escalamos, há espaço para crescer sua carreira e responsabilidades

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Colaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.

  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience
description:
Title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Payroll Project Manager
description:
Location : Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Duration : 9 Months (Fixed-Term Contract), Starting Feb 2026

Reporting to: Director


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced Payroll Project Manager to lead the end-to-end implementation of Client’s new payroll system and service model. You will serve as the primary bridge between Client’s internal stakeholders (HR, Finance, IT), local partner and Neeyamo implementation teams. Your mission is to ensure that the implementation is seamless, compliant with Brazilian labor laws (CLT), and delivered on time and within budget.


Key Responsibilities

 Project Leadership: Act as the single point of contact for the external payroll provider,

ensuring their delivery matches our business requirements and local statutory needs.

 Implementation Oversight: Manage the full implementation lifecycle: discovery, data

migration, parallel runs, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and \"Go-Live.\"

 Stakeholder Management: Facilitate weekly status meetings with internal leadership and the

provider’s project team to track progress and unblock issues.

 Data Migration & Quality: Lead the cleansing and mapping of legacy data into the new

provider’s platform, ensuring 100% accuracy in employee records and year-to-date balances.

 Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to automate workflows between HRIS and the

new payroll platform to reduce manual intervention.

 Risk Mitigation: Maintain a Risk & Issue Log, proactively identifying bottlenecks that could

delay the 10-month timeline.

 Planning : Compliance: Support future implementation planning, prepare Wave Plans, and

ensure adherence to project management frameworks


Qualifications & Skills

 Experience: 7+ years in Payroll implementations &; project management or HR Project

Management, with at least 2 successful large-scale payroll implementations.

 Local Expertise: Knowledge of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and the eSocial framework is

beneficial.

 Language : Fluency in Portuguese and English (required for global reporting).

 Technical Savvy : Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana) and

advanced Excel. Experience/ knowledge on any Ewaider& ;Co suite of products will be an

additional advantage.

 Communication: Strong negotiation skills to manage vendor performance and expectations.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Colaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI & Orchestration)
description:
Company Description


A Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.


Mais informações: Coru Website


Job Description


Como Senior Software Engenieer, você irá liderar a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento da nossa plataforma de orquestração de agentes de IA. A sua missão não é \"reinventar a roda\" no que diz respeito aos LLMs, mas sim construir uma infraestrutura robusta, escalável e flexível que integre as melhores soluções do mercado numa experiência de utilizador perfeita. Será uma peça fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma para um orquestrador de IA de classe mundial.


Responsabilidades:


1. Arquitetura e Orquestração

  • Design do sistema: arquitetar micros serviços escaláveis e camadas de orquestração que possam lidar com vários fornecedores de IA e fluxos de trabalho complexos de agentes;
  • Estratégia de integração: avaliar e integrar serviços de IA de terceiros (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, etc.), garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos;
  • Desenvolvimento de API: projetar e manter APIs de alto desempenho e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para dar suporte a interações em tempo real com agentes.


2. Full-Stack Development (Node.js/React)

  • Excelência em backend: criar serviços seguros, testáveis e sustentáveis usando NestJS e TypeScript;
  • Integração de frontend: colaborar no frontend Next.js/React para garantir que resultados complexos de IA sejam apresentados de forma intuitiva para os utilizadores;
  • Gestão de bases de dados: projetar e otimizar esquemas de bases de dados relacionais (SQL) para dar suporte à gestão complexa de estados para agentes de IA.


3. Produtividade aumentada por IA

  • Fluxo de trabalho moderno: usar e defender ativamente ferramentas de desenvolvimento baseadas em IA (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) para acelerar a entrega e manter a qualidade do código.
  • Evolução contínua: manter-se atualizado sobre as ferramentas e estruturas de IA mais recentes para garantir que a nossa camada de orquestração permaneça na vanguarda.


4. Liderança e Mentoria

  • Visão técnica: fornecer orientação técnica sobre decisões de \"Build vs buy\" relacionadas com componentes de IA;
  • Melhores práticas: defender código limpo, CI/CD e padrões rigorosos de documentação dentro da equipa de engenharia.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência: Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Backend: Forte proficiência em Node.js e TypeScript (experiência com NestJS é uma vantagem significativa);
  • Frontend: Sólida experiência com React e Next.js;
  • Bases de dados: Conhecimento especializado em SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou similar);
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experiência com AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker e pipelines CI/CD modernos;
  • Ferramentas de IA: Conforto e alta proficiência na utilização de assistentes de codificação de IA (Cursor, Copilot) para aumentar a produtividade pessoal e da equipa.


Competências Essenciais

  • Mentalidade generalista: capacidade de resolver problemas em toda a pilha sem estar vinculado a um nicho específico \"apenas de IA\";
  • Pensamento arquitetônico: capacidade de projetar sistemas modulares e fáceis de adaptar à medida que o panorama da IA muda;
  • Orientado para resultados: focado em entregar valor ao utilizador, em vez de projetar ferramentas internas de forma excessiva.


Desejável/ Plus

  • Experiência na criação ou manutenção de fluxos de trabalho ou orquestradores Agentic;
  • Familiaridade com bases de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate) ou arquiteturas RAG;
  • Experiência com Python (para pontes de serviço de IA específicas);
  • Compreensão da observabilidade e gestão de custos de LLM.



Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:

Características Pessoais

  • Pessoa orientada aos valores de: aprendizado contínuo, colaboração, honestidade, paixão, coragem e responsabilidade.
  • Capacidade de tomar iniciativa e de se responsabilizar pelos resultados individuais e do time.
  • Perfil detalhista, bem organizado e com boas habilidades de gestão do tempo.
  • Disciplinado(a), com alto nível de energia e espírito competitivo.
  • Capacidade de negociação e interação para apresentar propostas de forma assertiva, gerando benefícios para todas as partes envolvidas.
  • Escuta ativa com colegas e stakeholders: identificar necessidades, demonstrar interesse, fornecer e receber feedback, gerir conflitos, gerar confiança e compartilhar informações relevantes com o time.
  • Autoconsciência emocional, capacidade de regular emoções em momentos de estresse e frustração, e de lidar com conflitos de forma construtiva, transformando-os em oportunidades de aprendizado.

title: World-Class P-1, O-1, EB-1A Visa Petition Writers
description:
World-Class P-1, O-1, EB-1A Visa Petition Writers – Cricket & Tech

Work with the immigration team behind cricket legends. Now hiring writers for our tech expansion.

You know the names: Shahid Afridi. Suresh Raina. Irfan Pathan. Misbah-ul-Haq. Sreesanth. Mohammad Hafeez. Robin Uthappa.


We helped them compete in the United States. Now we're using the same proven tactics to help AI/ML founders, researchers, and engineers obtain O-1 and EB-1A visas.

About Us

We are a US-based immigration law firm with 500+ visa approvals and a 94% success rate. Our clients include world-class athletes, elite entertainers, and now – extraordinary tech talent. We've built proprietary AI tools and world-class templates that make petition writing faster and more effective than traditional firms.

Research tools powered by xtraordinaryresearch.com

The Role

We're hiring full-time Petition Writers to draft P-1, O-1, and EB-1A visa petitions for:

  • Professional athletes (cricket, boxing, MMA, football)
  • AI/ML engineers, researchers, and founders
  • Tech executives with extraordinary ability credentials

What You'll Do

  • Draft persuasive support letters using our proven templates
  • Map client achievements to USCIS criteria (awards, publications, critical roles, high salary, etc.)
  • Organize exhibits using our internal PDF tools
  • Conduct supplemental research using AI-powered tools
  • Work directly with US-licensed attorneys on case strategy

What We're Looking For

  • US immigration petition writing experience (REQUIRED – ex-Deel, Plymouth Street, Boundless, or US law firm experience preferred)
  • Exceptional English writing skills
  • Ability to translate technical achievements (ML papers, patents, GitHub contributions) into compelling legal narratives
  • Self-directed, detail-oriented, fast learner

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote position
  • Competitive salary + performance incentives
  • Flexible hours
  • Work on high-profile cases (athletes you watch, tech founders building the future)
  • AI-powered tools that do the heavy lifting – you focus on the writing
  • Growth opportunity as we scale our tech immigration practice

Location: Remote

title: Azure Analytics Architect
description:
Job Title: Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Azure Fabric

Location: Remote / Flexible

Experience: 12+ years in data engineering and analytics solutions

Role Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Analytics Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks, Azure Fabric, and related cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in big data, data engineering, cloud computing, and SQL, and will provide technical leadership to ensure scalable, high-performance data solutions aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Azure Fabric.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Oversee end-to-end implementation of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data transformation workflows.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services such as Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory, as well as on-premise systems.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices for code quality, data security, and scalability.
  • Mentor and guide the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Maintain proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, ensuring compliance with governance standards.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in Databricks, Azure analytics, and related technologies to drive innovation.

Essential Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark) and frameworks such as PySpark.
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices and data governance.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Familiarity with Spark Streaming for real-time data processing.
  • Experience with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and infrastructure-as-code practices.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Leadership and mentoring abilities to guide a team of data engineers effectively.
  • Proactive and collaborative approach to cross-functional teamwork.

Educational Qualification:

  • Minimum: BCA, MCA, BE, B.Tech, or equivalent.
  • Preferred: M.Tech or MS in a relevant field.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Application Architect - Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Title: Applications Architect

Competency Level: C5


Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Applications Architect with strong expertise in application modernization and Azure PaaS platforms. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of application architecture, cloud migration strategies, and modern hosting approaches, along with proven leadership experience guiding and managing technical teams.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead application architecture, design, and modernization initiatives for enterprise-scale applications.
  • Modernize and migrate applications from on-premises or legacy platforms to Azure PaaS .
  • Host, configure, and optimize applications on IIS and Azure services.
  • Design and implement solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Container Instances .
  • Analyze application architecture, dependencies, and integrations to define optimal migration pathways.
  • Perform application performance assessments before and after migration .
  • Containerize web applications and services, and manage deployment on Kubernetes.
  • Design Azure Landing Zones and define the Azure target-state solution architecture based on customer infrastructure landscapes.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Data Platform, DevOps, and Integration teams to ensure cloud adoption aligns with best practices.
  • Ensure solutions align with Azure strategy, business objectives, application and infrastructure requirements, and overall value realization.
  • Lead and technically guide teams of 5+ members , providing mentorship and architectural direction.
  • Work closely with internal teams, customers, and project managers to gather requirements and propose effective migration solutions.
  • Prepare and deliver solution architectures, technical documentation, and presentations to stakeholders.


Primary Skills & Technical Expertise

  • 13+ years of hands-on experience in application development and modernization .
  • Strong web application development experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing and hosting applications on Azure PaaS .
  • Expertise in application hosting, configuration, and optimization on Azure.
  • Strong understanding of database connectivity and configuration .
  • Proven ability to analyze application dependencies and integration points.
  • Experience with containerization of frontend applications and web services.
  • In-depth knowledge of hosting and operating containerized applications on Kubernetes / AKS .
  • Strong understanding of application migration scenarios, strategies, and pathways.


Secondary Skills

  • Experience working with internal stakeholders, customers, and project managers to define migration requirements.
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure PaaS services.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of containerization and AKS operations.


Soft Skills

  • Strong customer-facing skills with the ability to build and maintain client relationships.
  • Positive attitude with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage and lead customer discussions and technical calls.
  • Strong presentation skills for solution and architecture proposals.
  • Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Technology Stack / Languages

  • .NET
  • Java
  • Angular / React
  • Python

title: Projetista de Produto
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil) , ampliando sua presença no mercado global.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
We are hiring a full-time Salesforce Developer  to support a fast-moving merchant cash advance company. This role is focused on fixing, optimizing, and improving the Salesforce environment the sales team uses every day. You will handle UI updates, system configuration, integrations, and fast-turnaround fixes that directly impact how quickly deals move through the pipeline. Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Hours: 9am–5pm EST.

Salary: $4,000/mo


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Salesforce configuration: fields, formulas, layouts, list views, role hierarchy, and sharing settings
  • Set up and maintain integrations — especially telephony tools like RingCentral inside Salesforce
  • Improve UI and usability for reps, ensuring workflows are clear and easy to follow
  • Build small Lightning components or UI enhancements when needed
  • Troubleshoot and fix Lightning integration issues, permission problems, and visibility restrictions
  • Adjust and maintain workflow automation (Flow, processes, rules) to support the sales process
  • Update dashboards, create filtered list views, and improve record access structure
  • Build and refine CRM actions such as the “Next Opportunity” button and other quick actions
  • Handle fast-turnaround tasks when urgent fixes are needed (same-day or <30 minutes when possible)
  • Clean up confusing configurations, inconsistent UI, or broken logic
  • Document changes and communicate clearly with leadership about what was done and why


Key Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Experience with Lightning UI (components, layouts, actions, navigation)
  • Ability to diagnose and fix permission issues, sharing rules, and record visibility
  • Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)
  • Strong grasp of Salesforce automation: Flows, process automations, workflow rules
  • Able to move quickly, prioritize urgent fixes, and troubleshoot without hand-holding
  • Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy
  • Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet
  • Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with merchant cash advance companies
  • Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization
  • Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Node.js
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Node.js)

Location: Remote – Brazil

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: Negotiable


About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with strong experience in Java-based distributed systems , stream-based processing , and Node.js services . In this role, you will design, build, and operate backend services that handle high-throughput workloads , integrate with cloud platforms , and support business-critical applications .

You will work closely with architects, product teams, and other engineers while leveraging modern infrastructure and CI/CD tooling, including Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, AWS, and GCP .

  • Design, implement, and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Node.js
  • Build and optimize message-driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka
  • Develop scalable, resilient APIs and backend services
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following industry best practices
  • Deploy, monitor, and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations
  • Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and operational readiness activities
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across services and infrastructure
  • Prototype and evaluate new technologies to reduce costs and increase engineering velocity

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong experience with Java in backend or distributed systems environments
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, topics, offsets, stream processing)
  • Proficiency in Node.js for backend application development
  • Experience deploying and maintaining services on Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP
  • Solid understanding of software design patterns, system architecture, and microservices principles
  • Experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL , including schema design, performance tuning, and migrations
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a distributed/remote team environment


Nice to Have

  • Experience with VOD / Streaming platforms
  • Basic React experience (frontend integration, state/context management, UI components)
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Helm, etc.)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog or New Relic

description:

Colaboração direta com equipes de finanças e operações

Ambiente remoto com flexibilidade

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
We are hiring a full-time Salesforce Developer  to support a fast-moving merchant cash advance company. This role is focused on fixing, optimizing, and improving the Salesforce environment the sales team uses every day. You will handle UI updates, system configuration, integrations, and fast-turnaround fixes that directly impact how quickly deals move through the pipeline. Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Hours: 9am–5pm EST.

Salary: $4,000/mo


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Salesforce configuration: fields, formulas, layouts, list views, role hierarchy, and sharing settings
  • Set up and maintain integrations — especially telephony tools like RingCentral inside Salesforce
  • Improve UI and usability for reps, ensuring workflows are clear and easy to follow
  • Build small Lightning components or UI enhancements when needed
  • Troubleshoot and fix Lightning integration issues, permission problems, and visibility restrictions
  • Adjust and maintain workflow automation (Flow, processes, rules) to support the sales process
  • Update dashboards, create filtered list views, and improve record access structure
  • Build and refine CRM actions such as the “Next Opportunity” button and other quick actions
  • Handle fast-turnaround tasks when urgent fixes are needed (same-day or <30 minutes when possible)
  • Clean up confusing configurations, inconsistent UI, or broken logic
  • Document changes and communicate clearly with leadership about what was done and why


Key Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Experience with Lightning UI (components, layouts, actions, navigation)
  • Ability to diagnose and fix permission issues, sharing rules, and record visibility
  • Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)
  • Strong grasp of Salesforce automation: Flows, process automations, workflow rules
  • Able to move quickly, prioritize urgent fixes, and troubleshoot without hand-holding
  • Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy
  • Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet
  • Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with merchant cash advance companies
  • Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization
  • Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Node.js
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Node.js)

Location: Remote – Brazil

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: Negotiable


About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with strong experience in Java-based distributed systems , stream-based processing , and Node.js services . In this role, you will design, build, and operate backend services that handle high-throughput workloads , integrate with cloud platforms , and support business-critical applications .

You will work closely with architects, product teams, and other engineers while leveraging modern infrastructure and CI/CD tooling, including Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, AWS, and GCP .

Key Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Node.js
  • Build and optimize message-driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka
  • Develop scalable, resilient APIs and backend services
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following industry best practices
  • Deploy, monitor, and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations
  • Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and operational readiness activities
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across services and infrastructure
  • Prototype and evaluate new technologies to reduce costs and increase engineering velocity


Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong experience with Java in backend or distributed systems environments
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, topics, offsets, stream processing)
  • Proficiency in Node.js for backend application development
  • Experience deploying and maintaining services on Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP
  • Solid understanding of software design patterns, system architecture, and microservices principles
  • Experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL , including schema design, performance tuning, and migrations
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a distributed/remote team environment


Nice to Have

  • Experience with VOD / Streaming platforms
  • Basic React experience (frontend integration, state/context management, UI components)
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Helm, etc.)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog or New Relic

title: Projetista de Produto
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil) , ampliando sua presença no mercado global.


Estamos a procura de Projetistas de Produto Pleno e Sênior.


Áreas:

  • Body in White;
  • Closures;
  • Internal Trims;
  • External Trims;


Formação:

  • Engenharia mecânica, Mecatrônica ou Produção.
  • Técnico em Mecânica ou Mecatrônica.


Requisitos:

  • 5 anos ou mais de experiência como projetista de desenvolvimento de produto nas áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de peças plásticas;
  • Conhecimento e domínio dos softwares CATIA V5 ou Unigraphics NX (testes poderão ser aplicados durante o processo);
  • Oportunidades para desenvolvimento de atividades de forma remota / híbrida e presencial.
  • Desejável: Inglês Avançado (Não Mandatório);

title: Application Architect - Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Title: Applications Architect

Competency Level: C5


Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Applications Architect with strong expertise in application modernization and Azure PaaS platforms. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of application architecture, cloud migration strategies, and modern hosting approaches, along with proven leadership experience guiding and managing technical teams.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead application architecture, design, and modernization initiatives for enterprise-scale applications.
  • Modernize and migrate applications from on-premises or legacy platforms to Azure PaaS .
  • Host, configure, and optimize applications on IIS and Azure services.
  • Design and implement solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Container Instances .
  • Analyze application architecture, dependencies, and integrations to define optimal migration pathways.
  • Perform application performance assessments before and after migration .
  • Containerize web applications and services, and manage deployment on Kubernetes.
  • Design Azure Landing Zones and define the Azure target-state solution architecture based on customer infrastructure landscapes.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Data Platform, DevOps, and Integration teams to ensure cloud adoption aligns with best practices.
  • Ensure solutions align with Azure strategy, business objectives, application and infrastructure requirements, and overall value realization.
  • Lead and technically guide teams of 5+ members , providing mentorship and architectural direction.
  • Work closely with internal teams, customers, and project managers to gather requirements and propose effective migration solutions.
  • Prepare and deliver solution architectures, technical documentation, and presentations to stakeholders.


Primary Skills & Technical Expertise

  • 13+ years of hands-on experience in application development and modernization .
  • Strong web application development experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing and hosting applications on Azure PaaS .
  • Expertise in application hosting, configuration, and optimization on Azure.
  • Strong understanding of database connectivity and configuration .
  • Proven ability to analyze application dependencies and integration points.
  • Experience with containerization of frontend applications and web services.
  • In-depth knowledge of hosting and operating containerized applications on Kubernetes / AKS .
  • Strong understanding of application migration scenarios, strategies, and pathways.


Secondary Skills

  • Experience working with internal stakeholders, customers, and project managers to define migration requirements.
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure PaaS services.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of containerization and AKS operations.


Soft Skills

  • Strong customer-facing skills with the ability to build and maintain client relationships.
  • Positive attitude with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage and lead customer discussions and technical calls.
  • Strong presentation skills for solution and architecture proposals.
  • Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Technology Stack / Languages

  • .NET
  • Java
  • Angular / React
  • Python

Suas responsabilidades

  • Apoiar a análise e otimização de processos operacionais entre diferentes áreas

Trabalhe diretamente com o mercado dos EUA e desenvolva sua carreira em um ambiente que valoriza organização, autonomia e entrega de resultados .

title: Cloud FinOps Sênior - AWS, Azure e GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) FinOps Cloud que tenha olhar analítico e proatividade para gerenciar e otimizar custos relacionados à infraestrutura em nuvem. Essa pessoa será responsável por consolidar e apresentar dados financeiros e operacionais, garantindo clareza sobre os gastos da área e fornecendo insights estratégicos para a tomada de decisão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Monitorar e analisar os custos da infraestrutura em Cloud e Datadog, identificando os principais ofensores e oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir dashboards e relatórios financeiros que consolidem a visão de custos da área, garantindo transparência e controle.
  • Estruturar planilhas detalhadas com projeções e estimativas financeiras, facilitando o planejamento e a tomada de decisão.
  • Garantir a correta aplicação de TAGs nos recursos de Cloud para rastreamento preciso dos gastos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de desenvolvimento, operações e finanças para implementar práticas de FinOps e governança de custos.
  • Atuar de forma proativa, antecipando demandas e garantindo segurança nas informações para a liderança.
  • Preparar e apresentar análises estratégicas para a alta gestão, assegurando clareza sobre os investimentos da área.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Conhecimento básico em Cloud Computing para extração e análise de custos.
  • Experiência com Datadog para obter dados financeiros e de consumo.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar os principais ofensores de custos.
  • Entendimento de conceitos financeiros para estruturação de planilhas e estimativas.
  • Habilidade para construir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais (ferramenta flexível).
  • Proatividade e autonomia para investigar, consolidar e reportar informações críticas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para apresentar dados estratégicos para a alta gestão.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Front-End Engineering Technical Lead - (Fintech & Payments | Crypto) - Gowd
description:
We are looking for a Front-End Engineering Technical Lead  to own the design, architecture, and implementation of our user interfaces  across web and mobile experiences. This is a hands-on role  with strong emphasis on coding, design quality, and technical decision-making , not just coordination.


You will work directly with Product Management and UI/UX  to translate product vision into scalable, performant, and intuitive user interfaces, while setting engineering standards and best practices for the front-end stack. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys building, shaping architecture, while staying deeply involved in implementation.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadershiop & Architecture

  • Own the front-end architecture  for web and mobile applications.
  • Make technical design decisions  around frameworks, components, state management, performance, and scalability.
  • Define and enforce front-end best practices , coding standards, and UI consistency.


Hands-On Development

  • Design and implement complex, high-quality UI components.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces.
  • Lead by example through significant individual code contributions.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product  to refine requirements and scope.
  • Work directly with UI/UX  to ensure design fidelity and usability.
  • Translate product and design concepts into technical solutions.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of front-end engineering experience , with at least 1+ years in a technical leadership role
  • Strong experience with Angular  (required).
  • Experience with Flutter and/or React  (required).
  • Proven track record of building production-grade, scalable UI applications.
  • Strong understanding of:

Component-based architectures;

Responsive and accessible design;

Performance optimization;

  • Experience working closely with UI/UX.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Lit (LIT)  or Web Components.
  • Previous experience in fintech.
  • Knowledge of security best practices for front-end applications.


What We Offer, Why Join Gowd?

  • High ownership and technical influence.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Remote-first work model with flexibility and autonomy.
  • Opportunity to shape the user experience of a growing fintech platform with presence in Brasil and Mexico.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in payments, crypto, and Web3 innovation.
  • Build real-world, high-impact financial products.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Technical Project Manager

Competency: C5/C6 Overall 15+ years of cloud transformational & consulting projects migration experience. The purpose of this role is for managing all large-scale multiple Cloud transformation & Migrations projects within cloud practice.

The candidate must be dynamic, committed and capable of preparing/tracking & managing the Project schedules. Should have very good experience in project/program management especially on any cloud transformation /migration/consulting projects.

Should have executed large scale Cloud Migrations, SQL , Windows, Apps services, AVS, AVD Migrations or Integrations and Transformations

Agile Management

PRINCE2/PMP (Preferred)

ADO or any project Management tools, Azure Cloud, Database, Networking, Virtualization, Database, public Cloud etc.,

title: Desenvolvedor Android - Estágio
description:
Buscamos Estagiário para Desenvolvimento Android para atuar nos principais e novos projetos da Leal Apps, visando garantir o melhor produto para os nossos usuários.


Você será responsável por:

  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de apps Android nativos;
  • Auxiliar na implementação de novas funcionalidades e correções de bugs;
  • Colaborar com o time de produto e design para transformar requisitos em soluções práticas;
  • Participar de dailies, plannings e revisões técnica;
  • Aplicar boas práticas recomendadas.


O que é necessário:

  • Conhecimento em linguagem de programação Java/Kotlin;
  • Conhecimento básico em Android Studio e ciclo de vida de Activities/Fragments;
  • Noções de arquitetura MVVM, ViewModel, LiveData;
  • Uso básico de Git para versionamento de código;
  • Conhecimento em Room, Hilt ou outras bibliotecas Android modernas;
  • Formação em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins;
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade para trabalho remoto em equipe;
  • Escrever código limpo, bem estruturado e documentado;


A Leal Apps é uma startup em crescimento que atua no desenvolvimento de aplicativos próprios na área de saúde e bem estar, que tem como missão ajudar pessoas a criarem hábitos saudáveis através de aplicativos na área fitness.

São mais de 5 milhões de pessoas com hábitos saudáveis utilizando nossos apps, e por isso, queremos contar com um desenvolvedor Android disposto a crescer conosco a cada dia mais!
