title: Senior backend (typescript) engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.We’re looking for aSenior Backend (Typescript) Engineerto join on an initial 12-month B2 B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.Responsibilities:
You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
Optimising the product for continuous scalability
Delivering ongoing process improvement
Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
Meet aggressive development timelines.
Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.Requirements:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
Business Proficiency in English is essential
Meticulous attention to detail.
Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.The successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.What can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality:At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.
Problem Solving:We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior backend (typescript) engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.We’re looking for aSenior Backend (Typescript) Engineerto join on an initial 12-month B2 B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.Responsibilities:
You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
Optimising the product for continuous scalability
Delivering ongoing process improvement
Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
Meet aggressive development timelines.
Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.Requirements:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
Business Proficiency in English is essential
Meticulous attention to detail.
Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.The successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.What can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality:At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.
Problem Solving:We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Video editor
description:
We are…
A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.You Are...
An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team
You Will...
Edit audio and video for podcast, You Tube videos, advertisments, branded content, and moreto create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, You Tube, Tik Tok).
Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
and more...Job Requirements
You Have...
The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.Responsibilities:
You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
Optimising the product for continuous scalability
Delivering ongoing process improvement
Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
Meet aggressive development timelines.
Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.Requirements:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
Business Proficiency in English is essential
Meticulous attention to detail.
Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.The successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.What can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality:At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.
Problem Solving:We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Video editor
description:
We are…
A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.You Are...
An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team
You Will...
Edit audio and video for podcast, You Tube videos, advertisments, branded content, and moreto create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, You Tube, Tik Tok).
Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
and more...Job Requirements
You Have...
The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Human resources manager (middle level)
description:
About the Job
Turn Key is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our Turn Key team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U. S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, Yipit Data, Work Ramp, and Bell Xcel.
We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.OurHR Managerwill take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.Joining our team you will be focusing on
Working as an integral part of the Turn Key HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.Required Skills
A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
Client-facing experience
Advanced level of English
Great interpersonal and influencing skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Experience with HRIS
Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
applications
Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
Good level of emotional intelligence
Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
Learning agility
Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workloadPersonal competencies
Growth Mindset
Proactive and enthusiastic
Cultural Competence
Initiative and creativity
Achievement drive and optimism
Can-do attitude
Interpersonal and Communication Skills
Analytical and Problem-Solving SkillsWhy You Should Work at Turn Key
We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
Provided laptop (Mac Books)
Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
Private health & dental insurance
Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
Fully Remote work
Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
Access to a special online shop where you can use Turn Key coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Front-end & ui/ux designer (webflow + wordpress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + Word Press expert who can take a website from concept to completion.About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.
Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.What You’ll DoDesign and developresponsive, visually engaging websites inWebflow and Word Press.
Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designsthat align with user needs and client goals.
Translate approved designsinto fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or Word Press.
Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
Ensure all designs followUX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/Word Press capabilities.
Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.What You Bring3+ years of professional experiencedesigning AND developing websites usingWebflow and Word Press.
A strong portfolio showcasingweb design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds.
Proficiency inwireframing toolsand design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
Solid understanding ofHTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
Experience withsite performance optimizationand SEO-friendly design practices.
Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.Bonus PointsExperience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.Work DetailsHours:9 A. M. – 5 P. M. MST , Monday to Friday
Requires aworking level of written and spoken EnglishIf you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.

title: Msp delivery specialist (bilingual english | portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group
Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.Summary
Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.Job Description
Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and Power Point.
Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
3–5 years of experience inMSP operations, or contingent workforce management.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Power Point, Word) and experience withBeeline
Bilingual Competency acrossEnglish and Portuguese
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.Why Join Pinnacle Group?
At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.

title: .net aws developer (remote)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking aSenior. NET Developer with AWS experienceto work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil.Working hours: Pacific Time Zone. You will be required to follow the client's time zone.MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.Responsibilities :
Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using. NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP. NET, Web APIs, etc.
Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practicesRequirements:
10+ years of IT experience
Strong understanding of. NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (. NET framework)
Hands on experience inAWS environments( Azureis a plus)
The client expects the developer to have a very good understanding ofAWS features and toolssuch asLambda, SQS, SNS, EKS, Kubernetes , etc.
Experience supporting anintegration and transformationplatforms betweeninternal systems and external vendorsystems, especially those involving complex business logic.
Azure : Having knowledge in this area would be a bonus
Understanding of the QSR(fast food) industry : This is also considered a plus.
Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: .net aws developer (remote)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking aSenior. NET Developer with AWS experienceto work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil.Working hours: Pacific Time Zone. You will be required to follow the client's time zone.MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.Responsibilities :
Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using. NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP. NET, Web APIs, etc.
Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practicesRequirements:
10+ years of IT experience
Strong understanding of. NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (. NET framework)
Hands on experience inAWS environments( Azureis a plus)
The client expects the developer to have a very good understanding ofAWS features and toolssuch asLambda, SQS, SNS, EKS, Kubernetes , etc.
Experience supporting anintegration and transformationplatforms betweeninternal systems and external vendorsystems, especially those involving complex business logic.
Azure : Having knowledge in this area would be a bonus
Understanding of the QSR(fast food) industry : This is also considered a plus.
Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: Front-end & ui/ux designer (webflow + wordpress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + Word Press expert who can take a website from concept to completion.About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.
Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.What You’ll DoDesign and developresponsive, visually engaging websites inWebflow and Word Press.
Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designsthat align with user needs and client goals.
Translate approved designsinto fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or Word Press.
Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
Ensure all designs followUX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/Word Press capabilities.
Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.What You Bring3+ years of professional experiencedesigning AND developing websites usingWebflow and Word Press.
A strong portfolio showcasingweb design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds.
Proficiency inwireframing toolsand design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
Solid understanding ofHTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
Experience withsite performance optimizationand SEO-friendly design practices.
Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.Bonus PointsExperience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.Work DetailsHours:9 A. M. – 5 P. M. MST , Monday to Friday
Requires aworking level of written and spoken EnglishIf you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Assessor(a) de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica na construção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras personalizadas e alinhadas aos objetivos de curto, médio e longo prazo de cada cliente.Responsabilidades e atribuições:Onboarding (1º mês)
Um mês de imersão para você conhecer em profundidade nossos processos, ferramentas, cultura, soluções e a rotina estratégica do assessor na EQI.
Afinamento Comercial (2º mês)
Aqui você entra em um treinamento intensivo de vendas, prospecção e qualificação, aprendendo a gerar grandes oportunidades de negócio.
Captação e Estruturação (3º e 4º meses)
Além de seguir prospectando, você inicia a captação de recursos e a estruturação de carteiras, adquirindo experiência prática e recebendo, ao final, uma base de clientes para gestão e relacionamento.
Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com investidores de alta renda em todo o Brasil;
Manter ótimo relacionamento com clientes através de visitas e contatos recorrentes;
Estar constantemente atualizado sobre cenário macroeconômico, bem como oportunidades de mercado e produtos financeiros;
Assessorar e acompanhar constantemente a carteira de investimentos do cliente com foco em seus objetivos;
Saber gerenciar seu funil de vendas no CRM, com foco em levantar forecast e redução de ciclo comercial para atingimento de metas.O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?
• Fit Cultural;

• Disponibilidade em tempo integral (100% presencial);

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor's instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company's rules and regulations.
QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION
A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
A culinary school degree is required.
Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
Intermediate computer software skills required.
Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, "Debits/Credits", adjusting entries and corrections.
Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship's Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with
COAF
or relevant authorities.
Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company's enterprise risk management framework.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
